column2: the library's program in an older text: arizona v930 ipl/gprogs/fract.icn (Wampler, June 1994) is gprogs/fractlin.icn of the library (August 2000), the same code once comments, blank lines and semicolons are left out (MEASURED, a normalised diff against corpus ipl/gprogs/fractlin.icn and icon-stock-x's, both empty); fractlin is an entry of ipl_gprogs

no fixed answer: arizona v91 ipl/gpacks/vdemo/splat.icn (Lipp, random circles under GO, STOP, CLEAR and QUIT radio buttons; public domain, the library's statement in v91 docs/ipd242) draws one circle a pass while no event is pending, so what GO draws before STOP arrives is a matter of time: GO and STOP sent in one step gave four different pictures on four runs on icon-master-x (MEASURED); without GO its picture is the empty pane. It is no release of ipl_gprogs's splat (Townsend's paint splatters, another program)
